title: Copy Room
what: Cloning from a few seconds of speech: the copy keeps the voice and reads anything, in other languages too. Re-voicing takes a recorded line and says the same words in another voice, at the same length.

inputs.label: Sample
inputs.value: Mabel, 7.7 s (a made-up house voice: no real person was cloned)

inputs.label: New lines
inputs.value: I have never said these words before, and yet here they are, in my voice. / Nunca he dicho estas palabras, y sin embargo aquí están, con mi voz. / Je n'ai jamais dit ces mots, et pourtant les voici, avec ma voix. / この言葉を言ったことは一度もないのに、ちゃんと私の声で聞こえます。

inputs.label: Performance
inputs.value: Otto: Well, I never! Somebody has tidied the whole attic, and they even dusted the owl.

inputs.label: Re-voiced as
inputs.value: Nell, Hoot, Tilly (same words, same length)

snippet:
import requests
p = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/profiles", data={
    "name": "Mabel", "kind": "clone", "ref_text": SAMPLE_TEXT},
    files={"ref_audio": open("sample.wav", "rb")}).json()
wav = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/generate", data={
    "text": "Nunca he dicho estas palabras.", "language": "Spanish",
    "profile_id": p["id"]}).content
checks: Only made-up house voices are cloned in the public rooms
